status: Предыдущая проба отвергнута: «Слабо». Новая проба показана, не утверждена.
prompt:
Design ONE striking, deeply considered premium minimalist editorial book spread in Russian. Flat print artwork, landscape 380:250 proportions, two facing pages, subtle central gutter. NOT a photograph of a book, no perspective. Pure white, charcoal type, natural subdued photographic colors. No acid colors, gold, beige, retro, huge bold type, decorative UI, cards, arrows, irrelevant ornaments.

This must be a strong NEW composition, not the previous generic two-photo magazine layout. Art direction: intellectually playful contemporary art-book, precise grid, exquisite spacing, moderate typography, sophisticated restraint.

ONE VISUAL IDEA: the boundary of a photograph can remove the human context of an empty chair. Make the boundary physically visible through elegant editorial masking.
A single continuous panoramic photograph occupies the middle 55% height across BOTH pages, showing a contemporary courtyard table, a single empty slender black metal chair in foreground at the left third, two casually dressed people in quiet conversation towards the right third, bread and white cups on the table. Contemporary architectural stone courtyard, soft neutral daylight, extremely convincing editorial photography, not nostalgic, not commercial furniture ad. The scene is printed uninterrupted across the gutter with all critical content away from the fold.

Above and below the photo, exceptionally precise white page space. On LEFT page only, pure-white paper-like rectangular masking panels cover the photograph's peripheral background at top and sides so the empty chair is visible through a tall narrow WINDOW; as the panoramic picture extends into the RIGHT page the white mask ends and the fuller context of table and people is exposed. The whole composition shows one coherent scene, not two separate invented photographs and not a collage. The visible mask edges express the act of framing. Do not draw explanatory diagram arrows or measurement lines. Large image window, thoughtful negative space, excellent balance, no overlap on readable prose.

Top left small running text: "03 / Почему так". Beneath it restrained medium-weight contemporary sans heading, normal width, 22pt equivalent: "За рамкой\nтоже что-то есть". It must not dominate the page. Top right above image one small reflective line aligned to outer image edge: "Что меняется, когда мы видим больше?"
Small image captions beneath left and right image respectively: "Место" and "Окружение". No giant numbers.

Bottom quarter has two exquisitely set real reading columns, one per page, matching width, baseline, font size and leading. Crisp contemporary Russian book text around 11pt/15pt, readable and elegant, not Times-like, no contrasty fashion serif. Use normal-width humanist sans text, regular weight, not ultra-light. Text is not tiny decorative filler. Use these verbatim paragraphs, first left, second right:
"Мысленно закроем верхнюю половину фотографии листом бумаги. Останутся сиденье, ножки, край стола и камень под ними. Разговор людей исчезнет. Пустой стул станет главным действующим лицом, хотя ни один предмет не сдвинулся."
"В рабочем макете это легко пропустить. Фотографию обрезают, потому что нужна вертикальная карточка. Лица остались, значит, все в порядке. Но за краем мог исчезнуть предмет, на который смотрели люди, или жест, объяснявший их отношения."
Small footnote "Учебная сцена" and discreet page numbers 18, 19 at outer bottoms with generous safe margins.
Visual idea must read instantly, elegantly, without busy annotations. Preserve ample reading area and consider the spread as ONE composition. Produce finished-looking graphic design, not a wireframe.
review: Появилась общая композиция и маскирование сцены. Однако показано боковое ограничение кадра, тогда как абзац говорит о верхней половине. Геометрия стола через белую маску не подтверждает единый исходник. Для смысловой точности требуется один мастер сцены и реальные кропы. Не считать готовым объясняющим сравнением.
